name: my-home
description: Ecossistema Norty — my Home (gestão condominial) e Norty Car (gestão de locadoras)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @myhome/shared && npm run build -w @myhome/api && npm run build -w @myhome/web
scripts.build:car: npm run build -w @nortycar/shared && npm run build -w @nortycar/api && npm run build -w @nortycar/web
scripts.test:car: npm run build -w @nortycar/shared && npm test -w @nortycar/shared && npm run build -w @nortycar/api && npm test -w @nortycar/api
